company_name: Vayusodh Applied Systems and Technologies LLP
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized design support for process utilities critical to semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Vayusodh Applied Systems and Technologies LLP specializes in designing process utilities for semiconductor and photovoltaic industries, focusing on gas and chemical handling systems. They offer advanced solutions incorporating AI, automation, and safety features, serving both domestic and international markets.

regional_presence.India: The company serves pan-India projects, emphasizing its strong presence in the domestic market.
